question: My son is a Class of 2029 football player and my daughter is a Class of 2029 volleyball player. When can a Division I coach first contact each of them?
expectedFacts: Class of 2029 D1 football coaches may start calling, texting, and emailing on 15 June 2027, after sophomore year
Class of 2029 volleyball: the athlete may write at any time, but a D1 or D2 coach may not answer until 15 June 2027
Football off-campus contact opens 1 January of junior year, which is 1 January 2028 for this class
Volleyball D1 visits open 1 August 2027, before 11th grade
These are openings, not a race, and a verbal conversation is not a written offer
forbiddenPatterns: volleyball coaches can contact her in 9th grade
both sports open August 1 of junior year

question: What does James's football SOP say a highlight video should look like, and is the roster cap still 85 scholarships?
expectedFacts: Football highlight video: 3 to 5 minutes, about 25 plays, best plays first
No music, no sound effects, no slow motion, no sped-up clips
High and wide, press-box angle, all 22 players visible, athlete marked on every play
Full games should be ready behind the reel
At opted-in FBS schools the roster limit is 105, and the school may fund up to all 105

question: Our daughter plays club volleyball and AAU girls basketball. Which camps and club fees are waste, and what should we actually pay for?
expectedFacts: A camp or showcase before a named coach has answered is an expensive practice
A camp invite is not proof of interest; volleyball camps checked in the SOP were open to any entrant
Girls basketball club or AAU fees in the SOP run $700 to $4,400 plus uniforms, and only NCAA-certified events are worth it because a D1 coach cannot legally watch an unapproved event
A $5,000 girls basketball boarding camp is called a vacation, not recruiting
Volleyball: do not pay about $2,000 for a service and then stop emailing; club is where staffs watch, not the high-school fall season alone
Plan travel first; the trip often costs more than the camp fee
Girls basketball coaches may not call, text, or email from 1 April through 31 July, so silence then is the rule
forbiddenPatterns: buy the national circuit no matter her level
every camp invite means the coach wants her
guaranteed roster spot if you attend
